# Starlight

Astro integration for docs. Pages are Markdown, MDX or Markdoc content-collection entries; config is the `starlight({...})` call inside the Astro config.

## Detect

- Repo: `astro.config.{mjs,ts,mts,js}` that imports `@astrojs/starlight` and calls `starlight({...})` in `integrations`; `@astrojs/starlight` in `package.json`; pages under `src/content/docs/`; `src/content.config.ts` using `docsLoader()` / `docsSchema()`.
- Live site: `<meta name="generator" content="Starlight ...">` next to an Astro generator tag; `/_astro/` asset URLs; `<starlight-theme-select>` / `<starlight-toc>` elements.
- The `starlight(` call (or the Starlight generator tag) wins. An Astro site without it is not Starlight.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Pages: every `.md`, `.mdx`, `.mdoc` under `src/content/docs/`. Custom routes in `src/pages/` (`.astro`, `.html`) are not content: list them and report.
- Read the whole Astro config, every file it imports (sidebar arrays are often split out), `src/content.config.ts` (schema `extend` adds frontmatter keys), and `ec.config.mjs` if present.
- i18n: each `locales` key is a folder under `src/content/docs/` (`fr/`, `zh-cn/`); a `root` locale lives directly in `src/content/docs/`. No built-in versioning: a versioning plugin in `plugins` holds the extra trees; read its config (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- `draft: true` pages never reach production: mark them `excluded`.

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

Find the repo through the "Edit page" link (`editLink.baseUrl`). Otherwise list URLs from `/sitemap-index.xml` (generated when `site` is set) and convert each page's `.sl-markdown-content` element.

## Config → docs.json

Reference: https://starlight.astro.build/reference/configuration/

| Starlight                                                                                                                                                                                  | docs.json                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title` (string, or per-locale object)                                                                                                                                                     | `name` (default-locale value)                                                            |
| `description`                                                                                                                                                                              | `description`                                                                            |
| `logo.src` or `logo.light` / `logo.dark`                                                                                                                                                   | `logo` (string or `{ light, dark }`); move the files from `src/` into the repo           |
| `logo.replacesTitle`, `logo.alt`                                                                                                                                                           | drop and report                                                                          |
| `favicon` (path in `public/`)                                                                                                                                                              | `favicon`                                                                                |
| `social` (array of `{ icon, label, href }`; older object form `{ github: url }`)                                                                                                           | `navbar.links` (Starlight shows them in the header); GitHub/Discord entries take `type`  |
| `head` `meta` tags                                                                                                                                                                         | `seo.metatags`                                                                           |
| `head` analytics scripts (gtag, GTM, Plausible, ...)                                                                                                                                       | matching `integrations.*` key; other scripts: drop and report                            |
| `lastUpdated: true`                                                                                                                                                                        | `metadata.timestamp: true`                                                               |
| `expressiveCode.themes`                                                                                                                                                                    | `styling.codeblocks` (only Shiki theme names)                                            |
| `locales`, `defaultLocale`                                                                                                                                                                 | `navigation.languages`, `default: true` on the default                                   |
| `sidebar`                                                                                                                                                                                  | `navigation` (see Navigation)                                                            |
| `plugins`                                                                                                                                                                                  | per plugin: OpenAPI plugins → `mint migrate --topic api`; anything else: drop and report |
| `editLink`, `tableOfContents`, `pagination`, `pagefind`, `customCss`, `components` (overrides), `credits`, `titleDelimiter`, `disable404Route`, `routeMiddleware`, `markdown.headingLinks` | drop and report                                                                          |
| Astro `site`, `base`, `trailingSlash`                                                                                                                                                      | no field; see URLs and redirects                                                         |
| Astro `redirects`                                                                                                                                                                          | `redirects` (see URLs and redirects)                                                     |

## Navigation

Reference: https://starlight.astro.build/guides/sidebar/

- No `sidebar` config: Starlight autogenerates from the whole `src/content/docs/` tree (one group per folder, labelled with the folder name as written). Expand it the same way as `autogenerate` below.
- `'path/slug'` string or `{ slug }` → page `path/slug`. Label comes from the page `title`; a `label` override → `sidebarTitle` on that page.
- `{ label, link }` → not a page. External or non-docs links: report them (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- `{ label, items: [...] }` → `{ "group": label, "pages": [...] }`, recursing in order.
- `{ label, autogenerate: { directory } }` and `{ label, items: [{ autogenerate: { directory } }] }` → one group whose `pages` are the files of `directory`, each subfolder a nested group labelled with the folder name. A bare `{ autogenerate }` at any level splices its entries into the parent.
- Autogenerated order: alphabetical by file id; `sidebar.order` in a page's frontmatter overrides it (lower first). Confirm the merged order against the rendered sidebar (`npx astro build` then read `dist/`, or the live site) before writing it.
- Page frontmatter `sidebar.label` → `sidebarTitle`; `sidebar.hidden: true` → leave the page out of `navigation`; `sidebar.badge` (string or `{ text, variant }`) → page `tag` with the text. These only apply to autogenerated and `slug` entries.
- Item or group `badge` → page `tag` / group `tag` (text only; drop `variant`, `class`).
- `collapsed`: Starlight groups default open. Nested group without `collapsed: true` → `"expanded": true`. `autogenerate.collapsed: true` → leave its subgroups unexpanded. `collapsed` on a top-level group has no equivalent: report.
- `translations` on items/groups → the label for that group in each `navigation.languages` entry. Sidebar `slug`s omit the locale prefix: prepend the locale folder per language.
- `attrs` (on items, `autogenerate`, or `sidebar.attrs` frontmatter) → drop and report.

## Content conversion

Syntax reference: https://starlight.astro.build/guides/authoring-content/

| Starlight                                                         | Mintlify                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:::note` / `<Aside>` / `<Aside type="note">`                     | `<Note>`                                                                                                                               |
| `:::tip` / `<Aside type="tip">`                                   | `<Tip>`                                                                                                                                |
| `:::caution` / `<Aside type="caution">`                           | `<Warning>`                                                                                                                            |
| `:::danger` / `<Aside type="danger">`                             | `<Danger>`                                                                                                                             |
| `:::tip[Title]` / `<Aside title="Title">`                         | same callout (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                                                                           |
| aside `{icon="..."}` / `icon` prop                                | drop and report                                                                                                                        |
| `<Tabs syncKey>` + `<TabItem label icon>`                         | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title icon>` (drop `syncKey`)                                                                                         |
| `<Tabs>` whose items each hold only one code block                | `<CodeGroup>`, `label` → fence title                                                                                                   |
| `<Card title icon>`                                               | `<Card title icon>`                                                                                                                    |
| `<LinkCard title href description>`                               | `<Card title href>` with `description` as body                                                                                         |
| `<CardGrid>` (`stagger` dropped)                                  | `<Columns cols={2}>`                                                                                                                   |
| `<LinkButton href variant icon>`                                  | Markdown link; report `variant`                                                                                                        |
| `<Steps>` around an ordered list                                  | `<Steps>`, one `<Step title>` per item, title from the item's lead line; keep a plain list if items have no lead line                  |
| `<FileTree>` nested list                                          | `<FileTree>` nested list; strip trailing comments and bold highlights, keep `…` lines as plain items                                   |
| `<Badge text variant size>`                                       | `<Badge>text</Badge>`; variant → `color` (note blue, tip purple, caution yellow, danger red, success green, default gray); drop `size` |
| `<Icon name>`                                                     | `<Icon icon>` with a Font Awesome match, else drop                                                                                     |
| `<Code code lang title mark>`                                     | fenced block; resolve `?raw` imports and variables (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports)                                   |
| `<details><summary>S</summary>`                                   | `<Accordion title="S">`                                                                                                                |
| Markdoc `{% aside %}`, `{% tabs %}`, ... (`.mdoc`)                | the same mappings                                                                                                                      |
| `import ... from '@astrojs/starlight/components'`, `astro:assets` | delete (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                                                                                 |
| other `.astro` / framework component imports                      | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                                                                                        |

Expressive Code fence meta (https://expressive-code.com/key-features/text-markers/, /key-features/frames/):

| Source meta                                                                     | Mintlify                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title="x"`                                                                     | `title="x"`                                                    |
| file-name comment in the first 4 lines (`// src/a.js`, `# a.py`)                | remove the line, use it as the title                           |
| `{1,4-5}` / `mark={...}`                                                        | `highlight={1,4-5}`                                            |
| `ins={2}` / `del={3}`                                                           | `[!code ++]` / `[!code --]` comment on each line               |
| ` ```diff lang="js" ` with `+`/`-` lines                                        | ` ```js `, strip the prefixes, add `[!code ++]` / `[!code --]` |
| labelled ranges `{"A":5}`                                                       | `highlight={5}`; report the label                              |
| `showLineNumbers`                                                               | `lines`                                                        |
| `wrap`                                                                          | `wrap`                                                         |
| `collapse={1-5}`                                                                | `expandable` on the block; report the ranges                   |
| `"text"`, `/regex/`, `ins="text"`, `del="text"` inline markers                  | drop; report if meaningful                                     |
| `frame=...`, `startLineNumber`, `preserveIndent`, `hangingIndent`, `wrap=false` | drop                                                           |

Frontmatter (https://starlight.astro.build/reference/frontmatter/):

- `title` → `title`. `description` is metadata only; Starlight does not render it on the page (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter).
- `template: splash` → `mode: "custom"`. `hero` → rebuild as a heading, paragraph, image and `<Card>` links from its `title`, `tagline`, `image`, `actions`; report.
- `tableOfContents: false` → `mode: "wide"`. `pagefind: false` → `searchable: false`.
- `slug`: path only (see URLs). `sidebar`: navigation only.
- `editUrl`, `head`, `banner`, `lastUpdated`, `prev`, `next`, `tableOfContents` levels, `draft`, schema-`extend` keys → drop and report.

## Assets

- `public/*` is served at the site root (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- Images under `src/` (often `src/assets/`) are referenced relatively (`../../assets/x.png`), through aliases (`~/assets/x.png`, tsconfig `paths`), or imported (`import img from '...'` then `<Image src={img} />` from `astro:assets`). Move each file into the repo and rewrite every reference to a root-absolute path (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- `hero.image.file` / `dark` / `light` and `logo` paths point into `src/`: move those files too.

## URLs and redirects

- Path = file path under `src/content/docs/` minus extension, lowercased and slugified by Astro; `index` maps to its folder. A `slug` frontmatter replaces the whole path. Take the final list from `dist/` after `npx astro build`, or from the sitemap.
- Locales: with a `root` locale the default language has no prefix (`/page`), others use `/<folder>/page`; without `root` every language is prefixed. Keep the same folders so paths do not move.
- Missing translations: Starlight served the default-locale content at `/<locale>/page` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- `base: '/docs'`: every source URL started with the base (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- `trailingSlash: 'always'`: source canonical URLs end in `/` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- Astro `redirects: { '/old': '/new' }` or `{ status, destination }` → one `redirects` entry each. `[...slug]` → `:slug*`; `[slug]` → one entry per page (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).

## Known gaps

Report each: custom `.astro` pages and component overrides, aside icons, Expressive Code text markers and frames, `hero` and splash layouts, sidebar `attrs` and top-level `collapsed`, per-page `banner`/`head`/`prev`/`next`/`editUrl`, translation fallback pages, Pagefind settings, `customCss`, Starlight plugins without a Mintlify feature, and Astro integrations beyond Starlight.
